model.name: YOLOv8 oriented bounding box candidate
model.sourceUrl: owner-required official or self-trained YOLOv8 OBB model source
model.onnxExportCommand: yolo export model=yolov8n-obb.pt format=onnx imgsz=1024 opset=17 simplify=True dynamic=False

labels.sourceUrl: owner-required OBB dataset label source such as DOTAv1 labels

input.preprocessCommand: owner-required command that performs resize/letterbox/RGB/normalize/NCHW conversion

commands.yoloVisionRunCommand: dotnet run --project .\samples\YoloVision -- --model .\models\yolov8-obb.onnx --labels .\models\dota.names --input-data .\models\yolov8-obb-fp32.bin --input-shape 1x3x1024x1024 --tensor-rt-line 10 --family v8 --task obb --output-role-map boxes:obb,scores:scores,classes:classes,angles:angle --rotated-box-layout cx,cy,w,h,angle --angle-unit radians-or-owner-confirmed --layout auto --has-objectness auto --nms-mode rotated-class-aware --confidence 0.25 --iou-threshold 0.45

requiredEvidenceLines: Profile Family=v8 Task=OBB Layout=... Nms=... NmsMode=rotated-class-aware
proofChecklist.notProofUntil: owner backfills real assets for OBB, rotated-box metadata, hashes, run log, stdout/stderr summaries, and validator passes
proofChecklist.packageConsumerBoundary: This candidate can support real-model-runtime only; package-consumer-runtime must come from clean external package consumer validators.
